sources.title: GitHub - imanaswer/Lunar-Lander-PPO-: This project uses Proximal Policy ...
sources.snippet: This project is designed to explore and apply reinforcement learning (RL) techniques to solve the LunarLander-v2 environment provided by OpenAI's Gym. In this project, we use Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), a popular RL algorithm from Stable Baselines3, to train an agent to successfully land a lunar module on a simulated moon surface.
